skill.name: Backlog Prompt Contract
skill.purpose: Shared execution contract. Load this skill. Do not copy it into prompts.

write_path_resolution.first_rule: Path strings that start with src/ are LOGICAL (workspace-root) paths. Resolve them before any mkdir or write_file.
resolve: If cwd basename is src, OR cwd already contains artifacts/: ACTIVE_ROOT = cwd. Strip a leading src/ from every write/mkdir path.
Else if ./src exists: ACTIVE_ROOT = ./src. Write ACTIVE_ROOT/artifacts/... (do not mkdir another src).
Else: do not invent src. Write artifacts/... under cwd.
forbid: mkdir src when src already exists or cwd is src

output_tree.nested: Requirement → Epic → Feature → FAC/AAC → Technical-Stories/ST-### → SAC
output_tree.note: Prefix src/ only after resolve says cwd is workspace root.

schema.rule: Every JSON artifact must include all skill required_fields, non-empty.

naming_refs.rule: Always write human title/name plus id. Never id/number alone.

inline_details.rule: Write full business-rule, ADR, and migration details inline.

epic_names.when_provided: Use verbatim titles. One Epic per name.

feature_selection.when_empty: LLM decides Feature count per Epic.

markdown.rule: Human-readable only. No full JSON dump.

retry.rule: Rerun only the named incomplete agent.
